title: Staging MariaDB compatibility for workflow-control dispatch binding identifiers

phases.objective: Make the ordered Staging schema replay compatible with MariaDB 11.4 when workflow-control dispatch bindings use identifiers longer than the earlier 64-character column contract.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging schema bundle generator and disposable MariaDB 11.4
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact Staging checkout applies the ordered baseline and migrations through migration 1038 in a disposable local MariaDB 11.4 schema.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: platform_tool_dispatch_bindings accepts all migration-1038 workflow-control binding identifiers, the builder regression and ordered pre-use plan pass, and no provider or Production operation is performed.
steps: Load the canonical baseline and ordered migration chain in the isolated schema-bundle builder.
Create platform_tool_dispatch_bindings with the earlier contract, then widen binding_id to VARCHAR(128) before migration 1038 writes workflow-control bindings.
Apply migration 1038 metadata-only registry writers without calling GitHub or reading credential payloads.
Run the builder regression and plan-only audit, then require confirmed disposable replay before producing role bundles.
Keep Production mutation, provider mutation, deployment, credential payload reads, and data export forbidden.
assertions: The migration-1038 compatibility ALTER precedes the first platform_tool_dispatch_bindings writer.
The binding_id contract is VARCHAR(128) and preserves the existing relationship and endpoint scopes.
The patch introduces no provider call, external write, deployment, credential payload read, or data export.
The Staging builder regression and ordered pre-use plan remain successful before confirmed replay.
Production mutation remains explicitly forbidden even though the migration is classified as shared runtime.
